title: Unequal affine module sections are detected at an associated stalk
statement: Let L be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], N a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], and V an affine open such that N(V) is finite over O_L(V). For unequal sections s,t in N(V), there exists y in V such that the maximal ideal of O_{L,y} is associated to N_y, and the germs of s and t at y are unequal. Here associated means Mathlib IsAssociatedPrime; on a Noetherian ring this is equivalently the annihilator of an element.

source.place: Tag 0B3M, cyclic image subsheaf argument; Tag 05AR; affine reformulation using Tags 01IA, 01IB, 01HV, 0310

proof.text: The affine section ring is Noetherian by IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian. Suppose every associated stalk has equal germs of s and t. For an associated prime p of N(V), use the inverse affine chart isomorphism to obtain y in V with primeIdealOf(y)=p. Equip N_y with its section-ring action through the ring germ, and obtain its localized module germ map.

The stalk ring is a localization of the affine section ring at p. Its maximal ideal contracts to p by IsLocalization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal. Apply Mathlib Module.associatedPrimes.mem_associatedPrimes_of_comap_mem_associatedPrimes_of_isLocalizedModule to the localized module germ map. The maximal ideal is associated to N_y. This is precisely the general localization theorem recorded as the Mathlib match of lem-weil-pbc-associated-prime-localization-depth-zero, used here for a module rather than just the ring.

Our contrary assumption gives equal germs at y, hence equal values of the localization map. IsLocalizedModule.eq_iff_exists supplies c outside p with c • s = c • t, so c • (s-t)=0. Apply the elementwise zero criterion of injective_pi_localization_associatedPrimes to s-t. It yields s-t=0, contradicting s≠t.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0B3M and 05AR via affine localization; 0311 injectivity, 0310 localization, 01IB and 01HV affine dictionary

lean.statement:
theorem exists_associated_stalk_germ_ne_of_isAffineOpen
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (N : L.Modules)
    (hqc : N.IsQuasicoherent) (V : L.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (hfinite : Module.Finite (L.presheaf.obj (op V)) (N.val.obj (op V)))
    (s t : N.val.obj (op V)) (hne : s ≠ t) :
    ∃ (y : L) (hy : y ∈ V),
      IsAssociatedPrime (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (L.presheaf.stalk y))
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (X := L) N.val.presheaf y) ∧
      N.presheaf.germ V y hy s ≠ N.presheaf.germ V y hy t
